fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses a broad cone of arrows ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Swivel Gun
fusions.desc: Looses a heavy arrow that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. Foes more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

fusions.name: Following Sea
fusions.desc: When you have moved a long stretch, your critical hit chance rises 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
